title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics integration
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Add a lightweight per-prompt regression CI hook for the eval-harness to catch quality regressions early in PRs. The goal is to run a targeted subset of eval prompt-sets (fast buckets) in CI, compute per-prompt deltas against a stored baseline, and fail the check when a prompt exceeds a configurable regression threshold. This complements the existing full periodic eval runs and prevents regressions from being merged into main.

What this PR does (summary):
- introduces a new CI hook script (eval-harness/ci/per_prompt_ci_hook.py) that runs per-prompt evals, computes delta metrics (accuracy/f1/bleu depending on prompt type), and emits a JSON summary + JUnit-style artifact for CI.
- adds a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml) that runs the hook on PRs with changed model-serving code or eval set edits. Workflow is gated to run in the lightweight matrix (models: small/medium) and uses caching for baselines.
- integrates results upload to our metrics pipeline (ci/metrics_uploader.py) so per-prompt deltas appear in the eval dashboard and we can track regressions over time.
- introduces a new config for quality gates (eval-harness/configs/quality_gates.yaml) with per-prompt thresholds and skip/allow-lists.
- adds unit + integration tests (tests/test_per_prompt_hook.py, tests/fixtures/) and minimal docs (docs/dev/eval-ci.md).

Implementation notes:
- The hook compares the current run to a stored baseline JSON (eval-harness/baselines/per_prompt_baseline.json). If a prompt's metric delta exceeds the configured threshold, the hook marks that prompt as failed and returns non-zero, which fails the CI check.
- To reduce CI costs we only run the 'fast' prompt bucket by default and provide a matrix option for expanded runs. Short-circuits are included so the hook is a no-op when only unrelated docs are changed.
- Metrics uploader batches and retries with backoff; sensitive telemetry is scrubbed before upload.

Why now: Several recent regressions escaped fast PR reviews because per-prompt regressions were not visible on PRs (see ENG-4512). This hook significantly improves signal-to-noise for reviewers without requiring full eval runs on every PR.

Testing and CI:
- Local unit tests added and cover the threshold evaluation logic and JSON summary format.
- GitHub Actions workflow included; initial runs hit a lint error that was fixed in the second commit. Final CI status: all checks passing (build/test/lint/metrics upload).

Related: ENG-4512, ENG-4590; follow-ups planned for automatic baseline refresh and richer UI in the eval dashboard (ENG-4640).

Maya Chen (author): Added model matrix and try/except around model load; if OOM we mark the job as skipped for that model and continue. See second commit.
Sofia Patel (reviewer): Please add test coverage for the threshold edge-case where metric delta equals threshold. Also add clearer logging for which prompts failed and why.
Maya Chen (author): Added tests and improved logging output; included JUnit artifact for CI to display failures in GH checks.
